mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS ( ORDERS_SEQ, ORDERS_PRICE, ORDERS_PRIMARYPAY, ORDERS_STATUS, ORDERS_TIMESTAMP, MEMBER_NO, COURSE_SEQ, CANCEL_YN, CANCEL_TIMESTAMP, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, SCHEDULE_ID,TEMP_RESERVATION_ID,COURSE_TYPE ) VALUES ( SEQ_ORDERS.NEXTVAL, #{ordersPrice}, #{ordersPrimaryPay}, DEFAULT, DEFAULT, #{memberNo}, #{courseSeq}, DEFAULT, DEFAULT, DEFAULT, DEFAULT,DEFAULT,DEFAULT,'ON' )
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET ORDERS_STATUS='CANC', CANCEL_YN = 'Y', CANCEL_TIMESTAMP=SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ORDERS_SEQ = #{ordersSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, d.*, c.COURSE_TITLE FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN ORDER_DETAILS d ON o.ORDERS_SEQ = d.ORDERS_SEQ LEFT JOIN COURSE c ON o.COURSE_SEQ = c.COURSE_SEQ WHERE o.ORDERS_SEQ = #{ordersSeq}

SELECT o.*, d.*, c.COURSE_TITLE FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN ORDER_DETAILS d ON o.ORDERS_SEQ = d.ORDERS_SEQ LEFT JOIN COURSE c ON o.COURSE_SEQ = c.COURSE_SEQ WHERE o.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY o.ORDERS_TIMESTAMP DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND COURSE_SEQ = #{courseSeq} AND ORDERS_STATUS= 'PAID'
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET ORDERS_STATUS = 'CANC', CANCEL_YN = 'Y', CANCEL_TIMESTAMP = DEFAULT, UPDATED_AT = DEFAULT WHERE ORDERS_SEQ IN ( SELECT OD.ORDERS_SEQ FROM ORDER_DETAILS OD WHERE OD.ORDERS_PAYMENT_ID = #{ordersPaymentId} )
mapper.select: SELECT o.ORDERS_SEQ, o.ORDERS_PRICE, o.ORDERS_STATUS, o.ORDERS_TIMESTAMP, o.MEMBER_NO, o.COURSE_SEQ, o.SCHEDULE_ID, o.TEMP_RESERVATION_ID, o.COURSE_TYPE, d.ORDERS_SEQ, d.ORDERS_PAYMENT_ID, c.COURSE_TITLE, c.COURSE_PRICE, c.COURSE_DISCOUNT FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN ORDER_DETAILS d ON o.ORDERS_SEQ = d.ORDERS_SEQ LEFT JOIN COURSE c ON o.COURSE_SEQ = c.COURSE_SEQ WHERE o.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND d.ORDERS_PAYMENT_ID = #{ordersPaymentId}
